parts.label: PDK Transaxle Case (CG2.00 / CG2.20)
parts.function: Main alloy case of the 7-speed Porsche Doppelkupplung introduced on the 987.2 (2009): type CG2.00 on Boxster/Cayman, CG2.20 on the S models. Houses both part-transmissions, the shafts and the final drive. 987.1 cars use a Tiptronic S automatic or a manual gearbox instead.

parts.label: PDK Bellhousing / Transmission Case (Main)
parts.function: Aluminium alloy structural case enclosing the PDK gear set and clutch assembly. Contains two separate oil chambers: hydraulic/clutch oil and gear-wheel oil, split because of the high shearing strains in the differential (2009 Service Introduction, p66).

parts.label: PDK End Cover / Rear Cover
parts.function: Rear closing plate that seals the transmission case and provides bearing support at the tail end.

parts.label: PDK Oil Pan (Hydraulic-Oil Chamber)
parts.function: Lower sump of the hydraulic-oil chamber: 5.2 l of Pentosin FFL 3 hydraulic oil for the clutches, actuators and cooling, changed every 90,000 km (56,000 mi). The hydraulic control unit is installed in the oil pan area.

parts.label: PDK Oil Pan (Alternate / Revised Sump)
parts.function: Revised-specification lower sump used on later production runs; check production date before ordering.

parts.label: PDK Housing Filler Neck
parts.function: Filler neck on the transmission case through which PDK fluid is added. Level is set via oil overflow bores — one for the hydraulic oil (engine idling, PIWIS in Oil fill mode, within 5 minutes) and one on the opposite side for the gear-wheel oil.

parts.label: Clutch / Bell Housing
parts.function: Bell housing at the engine end that encloses the wet double clutch and mates to the engine. The engine/transmission flange shape was redesigned for the 987.2 engine generation, with a reinforced ribbed case structure behind it.

parts.label: Engine Mounting Flange / Retaining Plate
parts.function: Bolt flange / retaining plate that secures the PDK bellhousing to the rear face of the engine block.

parts.label: Wet Double Clutch (K1 Ø202 mm + K2 Ø153 mm)
parts.function: Radially arranged wet multi-plate clutch pair: outer clutch K1 (Ø202 mm) drives inner input shaft 1 for gears 1-3-5-7 + reverse; inner clutch K2 (Ø153 mm) drives hollow input shaft 2 for gears 2-4-6. Both clutches are open when depressurised, so the parking lock or brake must hold the car.

parts.label: Clutch Hydraulic Actuation Pistons
parts.function: Hydraulic actuation for each clutch pack (one circuit per part-transmission), pressurised by the hydraulic control unit. Clutch cooling flow is regulated between 0 and approx. 40 l/min by a cooling valve on the HCU.

parts.label: Dual-Mass Flywheel
parts.function: Engine torque is transmitted into the PDK clutches via a dual-mass flywheel (2009 Service Introduction, p90), which decouples engine torsional vibration from the driveline. Manual 987s use a dual-mass flywheel with a single-plate dry clutch (240 mm pressure plate; self-adjusting X-Tend clutch on S models).

parts.label: Clutch Release Bearing
parts.function: Support bearing at the clutch actuation pistons that transfers hydraulic apply force into the rotating clutch packs.

parts.label: Input Shaft 1 (Inner — Gears 1-3-5-7 + Reverse)
parts.function: Solid inner input shaft driven by outer clutch K1. Carries 1st, 3rd, 5th, 7th and the reverse drive gear (2009 Service Introduction, p80/89). Not serviceable separately — supplied with the complete PDK unit.

parts.label: Input Shaft 2 (Outer, Hollow — Gears 2-4-6)
parts.function: Hollow outer input shaft concentric with shaft 1, driven by inner clutch K2, carrying 2nd, 4th and 6th gears. Not serviceable separately.

parts.label: Main Shaft & Pinion Shaft
parts.function: The gear wheel set comprises the two input shafts, the main shaft, the pinion shaft and the intermediate gear wheel for reverse (Fig 3_69_09). The main and pinion shafts receive torque from the selected gear pair and deliver it to the hypoid final drive.

parts.label: Gear Sets (1st–7th + Reverse)
parts.function: Seven forward gear pairs plus reverse via an intermediate gear wheel. Ratios (987.2 PDK): 1st 3.91, 2nd 2.29, 3rd 1.65, 4th 1.30, 5th 1.08, 6th 0.88, 7th 0.62, reverse 3.55 (identical for base and S; only the spur-gear drive differs: 1.146 vs 1.114).

parts.label: Synchronizer Hubs & Shift Sleeves
parts.function: Fully synchronized shift-sleeve sets on both part-transmissions that match shaft speeds before engagement, allowing the next gear to be pre-selected while driving.

parts.label: Shift Rods & Forks (x4)
parts.function: Four hydraulically actuated shift rods, each switching two gears (4/6, 5/7, 1/3 and 2/reverse). Rods are locked in neutral and end positions, held by detents, and each carries a sensor magnet read by the distance-sensor tower (2009 Service Introduction, p87/98).

parts.label: Hydraulic Control Unit / Valve Body
parts.function: Hydraulic switching device in the oil pan area: port plate, intermediate plate and valve housing with 16 valves — system-pressure, gear valves EDS5/6, clutch valves EDS1/2, clutch selector EDS3, pressure control EDS4, cylinder/transmission selection, cooling and switch-over valves. Controls clutches, actuators, cooling flow and the parking-lock hydraulics.

parts.label: Solenoid Valves & EDS Pressure Regulators
parts.function: Two on/off solenoid valves plus proportional EDS pressure regulators on the valve body that modulate hydraulic pressure for clutch engagement, gear selection and cooler flow (Figs 3_45_09 / 3_83_09).

parts.label: Transmission Connector (16-pin)
parts.function: Case connector through which the distance and rpm sensor lines are led outwards; the internally-wired temperature sensor exits via a separate 20-pin connector (2009 Service Introduction, p97).

parts.label: Transmission Oil Pump
parts.function: Internal pump that supplies the hydraulic control unit with oil for the actuators, clutches, actuating cylinders, cooling and lubrication system (2009 Service Introduction, p93).

parts.label: PDK Fluid Filter and Oil Strainer
parts.function: Filter assembly that removes particulate contamination from the PDK hydraulic-oil circuit. Serviced with the hydraulic-oil change (every 90,000 km / 56,000 mi).

parts.label: PDK Fluid Temperature Sensor
parts.function: Temperature sensor permanently wired to the internal harness (led out via the 20-pin connector). Like all PDK sensors it is located inside the transmission and cannot be removed or installed from outside (2009 Service Introduction, p97).

parts.label: PDK Oil Cooler (Oil/Water Heat Exchanger)
parts.function: Fitted on the outside of the transmission near the bell housing. Cools the clutch/hydraulic oil, which heats up significantly more than the gear-wheel oil due to clutch friction; the gear-wheel oil is cooled sufficiently by the housing itself (Figs 3_85_09 / 3_86_09).

parts.label: PDK Cooler Water Hose (Supply)
parts.function: Cooler supply line from the engine cooling circuit to the PDK oil/water heat exchanger (Fig 3_86_09 item 2).

parts.label: PDK Cooler Water Hose (Return)
parts.function: Cooler return line from the PDK heat exchanger back to the engine coolant circuit (Fig 3_86_09 item 3).

parts.label: PDK Cooler Oil Hose
parts.function: Hydraulic-oil connection linking the clutch-oil circuit to the heat exchanger inlet/outlet.

parts.label: PDK Fluid Pressure Line
parts.function: High-pressure oil pipe from the pump outlet to the hydraulic control unit / valve body.

parts.label: PDK Fluid Return Line
parts.function: Return line that routes low-pressure fluid from the valve body back to the PDK sump.

parts.label: PDK Vent / Breather Hose
parts.function: Breather hose that vents internal transmission pressure to prevent seal blow-out and oil leakage.

parts.label: PDK Moulded Coolant Hose
parts.function: Pre-formed rubber hose connecting the coolant circuit to the PDK heat exchanger with a specific routed shape to avoid hot surfaces.

parts.label: Final Drive / Differential Assembly
parts.function: Hypoid final drive with differential splitting torque to the two rear driveshafts. 987.2 PDK data: rear-axle drive 11/34 (3.091) with spur-gear drive stage 1.146 (Boxster/Cayman) or 1.114 (S). An asymmetric limited-slip differential (22% traction / 27% overrun) was optional with 18/19-inch wheels.

parts.label: Hypoid Final Drive / Ring and Pinion
parts.function: Hypoid ring-and-pinion set (11/34 = 3.091 on the 987.2 PDK) stepping down gearbox output speed. Cover, flange, ring gear, differential and pinion shaft shown in Fig 3_75_09.

parts.label: Differential (Open, or Optional Mechanical LSD)
parts.function: Bevel-gear differential (ring gear, differential pinions, shaft bevel gears, planet-gear carrier — Fig 3_42_09). Optionally replaced by a plate-type limited-slip differential with 22% lock in traction and 27% in overrun.

parts.label: Drive Flanges / Output Flanges (x2)
parts.function: Splined flanges bolted to each side of the differential that accept the rear driveshaft CV joints.

parts.label: Output Flange Left
parts.function: Left-side drive flange connecting the differential to the left rear half-shaft CV joint.

parts.label: Output Flange Right
parts.function: Right-side drive flange connecting the differential to the right rear half-shaft CV joint.

parts.label: Rear Driveshafts / Half-Shafts (x2)
parts.function: CV axles transmitting final-drive torque to each rear wheel hub of the mid-engine 987.

parts.label: Output Shaft Oil Seal (Drive Flange Seal)
parts.function: Radial lip seal at each output flange preventing gear oil leakage where the driveshaft exits the differential housing. Replace at every driveshaft removal.

parts.label: PDK End Cover Seal Ring
parts.function: Sealing ring at the rear end cover interface that prevents fluid seepage between the housing and end plate.

parts.label: Input Shaft Oil Seal (External)
parts.function: External shaft oil seal at the bell housing face that prevents PDK fluid migrating toward the engine crankshaft seal.

parts.label: Input Shaft / Intermediate Shaft Seal Ring
parts.function: Internal sealing ring between the dual concentric input shafts preventing cross-leak between the two clutch oil circuits.

parts.label: PDK Oil Pan Gasket / Seal
parts.function: Sealing gasket between the lower oil pan and the main transmission case. Always replace when removing the sump.

parts.label: PDK End Cap O-Ring
parts.function: O-ring sealing the rear end cap to the transmission case, preventing fluid loss at the gearbox tail.

parts.label: PDK Sump Torx Bolt (x8)
parts.function: Torx-head bolt securing the PDK oil pan to the transmission case. Single-use — replace on every sump removal.

parts.label: Fluid Drain Plug
parts.function: Bottom plug removed to drain PDK hydraulic oil. Fit a new sealing washer at every service; the gear-oil chamber has its own drain/overflow on the opposite side.

parts.label: Drain Plug Sealing Washer
parts.function: Crush-type sealing washer under the PDK drain plug. Single-use — must be replaced every time the drain plug is removed.

parts.label: Oil Overflow / Level Bore
parts.function: Screw plug on the oil overflow bore used to set the hydraulic-oil level: engine idling, vehicle level, selector in P, clutch-cooling flow off via PIWIS Oil fill mode, top up until only drops emerge — completed within 5 minutes. A second overflow bore on the opposite side sets the gear-wheel oil level.

parts.label: PDK Oils (Two Chambers: FFL 3 + 75W-90)
parts.function: Two separate fills (2009 Service Introduction, p66): 5.2 l Pentosin FFL 3 hydraulic oil for clutches/actuators (change every 90,000 km / 56,000 mi) and 2.95 l Mobilube PTX Formula A SAE 75W-90 GL4.5 for the gear wheel set (change every 180,000 km / 112,000 mi). Never substitute standard ATF — wrong fluid destroys the wet clutches.

parts.label: Selector / Shift-Actuator Housing
parts.function: Houses the gear-selection mechanism above the shift rods. The shift rods are actuated hydraulically; there is no mechanical shift linkage from the cabin apart from the parking-lock engagement.

parts.label: Hydraulic Control Module (Valve Body Assembly)
parts.function: Combined hydraulic/electric module built from port plate, intermediate plate and valve housing (M6 through-bolts, retaining brackets — Figs 3_45_09 / 3_46_09). Actuates clutches and gear shifts, provides limp-home hold functions and controls the parking lock hydraulically.

parts.label: Selector Shaft (Parking-Lock Engagement)
parts.function: Selector shaft with detent disc and connecting rod that engages the parking-lock catch purely mechanically when P is selected (Fig 3_78_09).

parts.label: Parking Lock (Catch & Parking-Lock Gear)
parts.function: Because the depressurised PDK clutches are open and cannot hold the car, a parking lock blocks the final drive: a catch engages the toothing of the parking-lock gear on the pinion shaft when P is selected (engaged mechanically via the selector lever, released hydraulically — 2009 Service Introduction, p88/93).

parts.label: Transmission Control Unit (PDK)
parts.function: Located in the rear right of the luggage compartment beneath the cover (2009 Service Introduction, p102). Connected via CAN bus; processes selector position, SPORT/SPORT PLUS, pedal, brake, wheel speeds, acceleration, altitude and temperature inputs to run the shift programs and driver-type detection.

parts.label: PDK Gear Selector Lever (Cabin)
parts.function: Centre-console selector (P/R/N/D/M) that reports the driver's request to the transmission control unit; P also engages the parking lock mechanically. Shift strategy is sharpened by the optional SPORT / SPORT PLUS buttons (Sport Chrono).

parts.label: Steering-Wheel Gearshift Switches
parts.function: Steering-wheel rocker switches (sliding gearshift switches on the standard 987.2 PDK wheel) that send manual upshift and downshift requests to the transmission control unit.

parts.label: RPM Sensors (x2, Internal)
parts.function: Two rpm sensors combined in one housing inside the transmission, wired out via the 16-pin connector together with the four distance sensors (2009 Service Introduction, p97). All PDK sensors are internal and cannot be replaced from outside.

parts.label: Transaxle Rear Mount (Hydro-Mount)
parts.function: Rear rubber hydro-mount supporting the gearbox tail and isolating driveline vibration from the chassis.

parts.label: Transaxle Mount Console / Bracket
parts.function: Structural console bolting the hydro-mount to the chassis subframe, carrying transaxle vertical and lateral loads.

parts.label: Drive Flange Snap Ring / Retaining Circlip
parts.function: Circlip retaining the output drive flange axially within the differential bearing carrier.

parts.label: Differential Bearing Bush
parts.function: Bearing bush in the differential carrier supporting the drive flange and absorbing radial loads from the half-shaft.
